text: つよく　なれば　ガードマンの　かわりに　なるしね

structure.jp: ガードマンの　かわりに　なる
structure.en: they can take the place of a guard

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: ば means 'if'. つよく　なれば = 'if (they) get strong'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: An adjective's く form plus なる means 'become'. つよくなる = 'become strong'.

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し gives a reason as one of several, and ね asks for agreement. なるしね = 'and they will, after all'.
